<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Thread & Co. | Garment Store</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#282720;--muted:#6f6b60;--cream:#f7f3ea;--paper:#fffdf8;--line:#e5dfd3;--accent:#a16f4a;--dark:#262721}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink)}
header{background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
.nav{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:16px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.brand{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:3px}.navlinks{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
button,.navlinks a{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffdf8;color:var(--ink);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px}
button.primary{background:var(--dark);color:white;border-color:var(--dark)}button:hover,.navlinks a:hover{opacity:.8}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:22px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:28px;background:#ece5d8;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
.hero-copy{padding:36px}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:bold}
h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.04;margin:12px 0}h2{margin-top:32px}.hero p{color:#5e594f;line-height:1.7}.hero img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:320px;object-fit:cover}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:20px 0}.stat,.panel,.product{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:18px}.stat strong{font-size:25px;display:block}.stat span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:16px 0}.toolbar input,.toolbar select,.panel input,.panel select{padding:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:white}
.products{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}.product{padding:0;overflow:hidden}.product img{width:100%;height:145px;object-fit:cover;background:#eee8dd}.product .inside{padding:14px}.product h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.price{font-weight:bold}.meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:7px 0 12px}.product select{width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:8px}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hidden{display:none!important}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.tablewrap{overflow:auto}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}th,td{text-align:left;padding:11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}th{background:#f2eee5}
.notice{background:#f3e7d8;border:1px solid #e6d1ba;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;color:#654b37;font-size:13px}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:35px 15px;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:800px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero img{max-height:280px}.products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nav{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}
@media(max-width:460px){.products{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero-copy{padding:24px}main{padding:14px}.product img{height:120px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="nav"><div class="brand">THREAD & CO.</div><div class="navlinks"><a href="#shop">Shop</a><a href="#cart">Cart <span id="cartCount">0</span></a><a href="#admin">Admin & Reports</a></div></div></header>
<main>
<section class="hero"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="eyebrow">Everyday essentials</div><h1>Good clothes.<br>Better basics.</h1><p>A simple garment-store demo for browsing clothing, choosing sizes, adding items to a cart, and viewing stock and sales reports.</p><a href="#shop"><button class="primary">Explore collection</button></a></div><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Thread and Co clothing catalog showing shirts, hoodie, jeans and tote bag"></section>
<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><strong id="statProducts">8</strong><span>Products in catalogue</span></div><div class="stat"><strong id="statUnits">0</strong><span>Units in sample inventory</span></div><div class="stat"><strong id="statSales">₹0</strong><span>Demo sales total</span></div></div>
<section id="shop"><div class="section-head"><h2>Shop the collection</h2><span class="meta">Demo store · Sample prices in INR</span></div>
<div class="toolbar"><input id="search" placeholder="Search products..." aria-label="Search products"><select id="category"><option value="All">All categories</option><option>T-shirts</option><option>Shirts</option><option>Hoodies</option><option>Bottoms</option><option>Accessories</option></select><select id="sort"><option value="default">Featured</option><option value="low">Price: low to high</option><option value="high">Price: high to low</option></select></div>
<div class="products" id="products"></div></section>
<section id="cart"><div class="section-head"><h2>Your cart</h2><button onclick="clearCart()">Clear cart</button></div><div class="panel"><div id="cartItems">Your cart is empty. Add a product to get started.</div><div class="section-head"><strong id="cartTotal">Total: ₹0</strong><button class="primary" onclick="checkout()">Proceed to demo checkout</button></div><p class="meta">This is a front-end assignment demo. No real payment is collected.</p></div></section>
<section id="admin"><div class="section-head"><h2>Admin dashboard</h2><button class="primary" onclick="renderAdmin()">Refresh reports</button></div><p class="meta">Sample admin tools for inventory management and reporting. Changes are kept in this browser session only.</p>
<div class="two"><div class="panel"><h3>Inventory by product and size</h3><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Size</th><th>Available</th><th>Adjust stock</th></tr></thead><tbody id="inventoryRows"></tbody></table></div></div>
<div class="panel"><h3>Sales report</h3><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><strong id="reportOrders">0</strong><span>Items sold</span></div><div class="stat"><strong id="reportRevenue">₹0</strong><span>Sales revenue</span></div><div class="stat"><strong id="reportLow">0</strong><span>Low-stock sizes</span></div></div><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Size</th><th>Sold</th><th>Available</th></tr></thead><tbody id="salesRows"></tbody></table></div><button onclick="downloadReport()">Download CSV report</button></div></div>
<div class="notice" style="margin-top:14px"><b>Financial terms:</b> Revenue is the money earned from sales before expenses. Inventory is the stock of goods available for sale. Cost of goods sold (COGS) is the purchase/production cost of items sold. Profit = revenue − COGS − other expenses. This demo calculates sales revenue, but does not estimate real profit because product costs and expenses are not provided.</div>
</section>
</main><footer>THREAD & CO. · BIS Second Assignment · Educational prototype</footer>
<script>
const productsData=[
{id:1,name:"Classic White Tee",category:"T-shirts",price:499,stock:{S:8,M:12,L:9,XL:5},sold:{S:2,M:5,L:3,XL:1},img:0},
{id:2,name:"Black Oversized Tee",category:"T-shirts",price:599,stock:{S:5,M:7,L:8,XL:4},sold:{S:1,M:3,L:2,XL:1},img:1},
{id:3,name:"Sky Blue Shirt",category:"Shirts",price:999,stock:{S:4,M:6,L:5,XL:3},sold:{S:1,M:2,L:1,XL:0},img:2},
{id:4,name:"Beige Hoodie",category:"Hoodies",price:1499,stock:{S:3,M:5,L:4,XL:2},sold:{S:0,M:2,L:1,XL:1},img:3},
{id:5,name:"Indigo Straight Jeans",category:"Bottoms",price:1299,stock:{S:3,M:5,L:4,XL:3},sold:{S:1,M:2,L:2,XL:0},img:4},
{id:6,name:"Ivory Sweatshirt",category:"Hoodies",price:1199,stock:{S:4,M:4,L:5,XL:2},sold:{S:0,M:1,L:2,XL:1},img:5},
{id:7,name:"Canvas Tote Bag",category:"Accessories",price:299,stock:{"One Size":15},sold:{"One Size":4},img:6},
{id:8,name:"Everyday Blue Tee",category:"T-shirts",price:549,stock:{S:7,M:8,L:6,XL:4},sold:{S:1,M:2,L:1,XL:1},img:0}
];
const catalogImage='data:image/png;base64,';
let cart=[],salesLog=[];
const money=n=>'₹'+Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');
function sizes(p){return Object.keys(p.stock)}
function allStock(){return productsData.reduce((a,p)=>a+Object.values(p.stock).reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0),0)}
function allSales(){return productsData.reduce((a,p)=>a+Object.entries(p.sold).reduce((x,[s,n])=>x+n*p.price,0),0)}
function renderProducts(){
 let q=document.getElementById('search').value.toLowerCase(),cat=document.getElementById('category').value,sort=document.getElementById('sort').value;
 let list=productsData.filter(p=>p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)&&(cat==='All'||p.category===cat));
 if(sort==='low')list.sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);if(sort==='high')list.sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price);
 document.getElementById('products').innerHTML=list.map(p=>`<article class="product"><img src="${catalogImage}" alt="${p.name} clothing product"><div class="inside"><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="price">${money(p.price)}</div><div class="meta">${p.category} · Available: ${Object.values(p.stock).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)} units</div><select id="size-${p.id}" aria-label="Choose size for ${p.name}">${sizes(p).map(s=>`<option value="${s}">${s} (${p.stock[s]} available)</option>`).join('')}</select><button class="primary" style="width:100%" onclick="addToCart(${p.id})">Add to cart</button></div></article>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('statProducts').textContent=productsData.length;document.getElementById('statUnits').textContent=allStock();document.getElementById('statSales').textContent=money(allSales());
}
function addToCart(id){let p=productsData.find(x=>x.id===id),s=document.getElementById('size-'+id).value;if(!p.stock[s]){alert('This size is out of stock.');return}let existing=cart.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.size===s);if(existing)existing.qty++;else cart.push({id,size:s,qty:1});renderCart()}
function renderCart(){document.getElementById('cartCount').textContent=cart.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.qty,0);let el=document.getElementById('cartItems');if(!cart.length)el.innerHTML='Your cart is empty. Add a product to get started.';else el.innerHTML='<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Size</th><th>Price</th><th>Qty</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+cart.map((x,i)=>{let p=productsData.find(y=>y.id===x.id);return `<tr><td>${p.name}</td><td>${x.size}</td><td>${money(p.price)}</td><td>${x.qty}</td><td><button onclick="removeCart(${i})">Remove</button></td></tr>`}).join('')+'</tbody></table></div>';document.getElementById('cartTotal').textContent='Total: '+money(cart.reduce((a,x)=>a+productsData.find(p=>p.id===x.id).price*x.qty,0))}
function removeCart(i){cart.splice(i,1);renderCart()}function clearCart(){cart=[];renderCart()}
function checkout(){if(!cart.length){alert('Your cart is empty.');return}for(let x of cart){let p=productsData.find(y=>y.id===x.id);if(p.stock[x.size]<x.qty){alert('Not enough stock for '+p.name+' size '+x.size);return}}
 let total=0;cart.forEach(x=>{let p=productsData.find(y=>y.id===x.id);p.stock[x.size]-=x.qty;p.sold[x.size]=(p.sold[x.size]||0)+x.qty;total+=p.price*x.qty;salesLog.push({product:p.name,size:x.size,qty:x.qty,revenue:p.price*x.qty,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString()})});
 alert('Demo checkout complete! Order total: '+money(total)+'. No payment was taken.');cart=[];renderCart();renderProducts();renderAdmin()}
function renderAdmin(){let ir=[],sr=[],sold=0,rev=0,low=0;productsData.forEach(p=>sizes(p).forEach(s=>{let n=p.stock[s],sn=p.sold[s]||0;if(n<=3)low++;sold+=sn;rev+=sn*p.price;ir.push(`<tr><td>${p.name}</td><td>${s}</td><td>${n}</td><td><button onclick="adjustStock(${p.id},'${s}',-1)">−</button> <button onclick="adjustStock(${p.id},'${s}',1)">+</button></td></tr>`);sr.push(`<tr><td>${p.name}</td><td>${s}</td><td>${sn}</td><td>${n}</td></tr>`)}));document.getElementById('inventoryRows').innerHTML=ir.join('');document.getElementById('salesRows').innerHTML=sr.join('');document.getElementById('reportOrders').textContent=sold;document.getElementById('reportRevenue').textContent=money(rev);document.getElementById('reportLow').textContent=low}
function adjustStock(id,s,d){let p=productsData.find(x=>x.id===id);p.stock[s]=Math.max(0,p.stock[s]+d);renderProducts();renderAdmin()}
function downloadReport(){let rows=[['Product','Size','Sold','Available','Unit Price INR','Sales Revenue INR']];productsData.forEach(p=>sizes(p).forEach(s=>rows.push([p.name,s,p.sold[s]||0,p.stock[s],p.price,(p.sold[s]||0)*p.price])));let csv=rows.map(r=>r.map(v=>'"'+String(v).replaceAll('"','""')+'"').join(',')).join('\n');let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));a.download='thread-and-co-sales-inventory-report.csv';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href)}
document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('input',renderProducts);document.getElementById('category').addEventListener('change',renderProducts);document.getElementById('sort').addEventListener('change',renderProducts);
renderProducts();renderCart();renderAdmin();
</script></body></html>
